name: Swan on the Long Box
summary: Lying face down on the long box with hands on the footbar, press the carriage away as the chest lifts.

layers.title: Extension prep
layers.text: Lift the chest only; the carriage stays still.

layers.title: Press the carriage
layers.text: Push the footbar away as the chest lifts.

cautions.note: Lying face down on the box.
Keep the range small or skip.
Hands on the footbar take weight.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
